problem: Retrospective cycle closures cannot be used as if known before candidate action. Historical 131/131 observed turn motifs lack nonclosing negatives and cannot identify counterfactual task reward.

proposed_pure_function.name: assess_prefix_proposal
inputs: whole list of genuine already selected original public events with event indices 1..t-1
current exact full public 7x7x3 original frame/mission/heading at decision t
one externally given proposed original action ID 0..6
outputs: digest of only public prefix and proposed action
proposed_pure_function.policy: The read-only classifier never selects/rejects a source action, produces no risk probability, and never produces an estimated future reward or terminal success.
proposed_pure_function.evidence_scope: all episodes are EXPOSED DEV; no new world, only source-selected events.

falsifiers: Two traces with identical authentic selected prefix and current public frame but divergent future selected actions/outcomes produce bit-identical advisory receipts at decision t.
No prefix-validation function accepts an event/observation with an unadmitted hidden private pose, map or inventory field.

Reject digest mismatch, action outside 0..6, synthetic bool action, incomplete original public frame, mission drift, event index breaks, noncontiguous actual before/after public hashes and nonzero external actions.
Reject requests after a terminal/truncated selected source event; reject over-limit original selected prefix, any untrusted end-of-episode aggregate used as current input.
When a motif flag is true, report not-calibrated, not an actionable turn veto; fabricate nonclosing future feedback to prove flag cannot know closure.
Treat a current externally suggested action as a hypothesis only, never an authenticated original MG56 parent proposal; preserve unknown parent ownership.
Avoid scope expansion into a learned predictor or new existing-controller/runner.
Run existing focused source-only Linux and Windows qualification, frozen-source Linux and Windows, and mandatory full integration Linux and Windows at exact final SHA.
